tenderSchedule.title: Empanelment of agencies for Empowering Aspiring Learners from Underrepresented Communities through need based livelihood interventions, Digital Learning, competitive examination preperation, entrepreneurship development and capacity building for preparing students of UAS Dharwad under Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SC-SP) at UAS Dharwad
tenderSchedule.description: Empanelment of agencies for Empowering Aspiring Learners from Underrepresented Communities through need based livelihood interventions, Digital Learning, competitive examination preperation, entrepreneurship development and capacity building for preparing students of UAS Dharwad under Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SC-SP) at UAS Dharwad

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender documents annexed
University reserve the right to cancel the tender at time without assigning any reasons thereto.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual turnover of INR 82.00 Lakhs is required and documents supporting this should be enclosed as an CA certificate, MSME exemptions can be claimed with proper documents for this clause
Declaration by the OEM - on his letter head and agent - on his letterhead should be mention that they are not blacklisted
ITR returns of last 3 financial years are required 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

minimum of 5 satisfaction letters - of last 5 years, issued by concerned authorities of ICAR supported universities/colleges are required for the OEM products - whose e resources are to be purchased, to certify that the OEM is capable of supplying resources, is mandatory
Valid registration of OEM or its authorized agents - Refer to tender document

itemList.itemName: PRODUCT 1- Spoken English, e-learning and international competency (online classes for a duration of 80 hours) - for details refer to tender document annexed. PRODUCT 2- Tutorial classes for competitive examination coaching and higher education advancement (Offline classes in Dharwad, Vijayapur, Hanumanamatti and Sirsi campuses for a duration of 200 Hours in each campuses) - for details refer to tender document annexed.
